title: Álvaro Montoro: European attention on Botafogo's midfielder
seoTitle: European interest in Botafogo midfielder Álvaro Montoro
subtitle: The Argentine who is rising in the Brasileirão and on the radar of European clubs
excerpt: Botafogo’s young midfielder Álvaro Montoro has attracted big European clubs after posting 6 goals, 7 assists and 59 appearances in the Brasileirão.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Argentine midfielder Álvaro Montoro, who joined Botafogo in June 2025 for almost eight million euros, is making waves on the international stage. His numbers – 6 goals and 7 assists in 59 matches – and the contract extension until 2030 have heightened interest from clubs such as Atlético Madrid and Manchester City.

Montoro at Botafogo: performance that creates value

Since debuting as a teenager with Vélez Sarsfield, Montoro quickly advanced in Brazilian football. At Botafogo, he became a key figure in midfield, directly contributing to the creation of plays. His 6 goals and 7 assists in 59 official games have raised his market value to about ten million euros.

Contract renewal: a sign of confidence

In response to the player's success, Botafogo renewed Montoro’s contract through the end of 2030, extending the original deal that was set to expire in 2029. The renewal demonstrates the club’s confidence in the youngster’s ability to keep improving.

Fouls suffered and interceptions: stats that highlight defensive presence

Montoro leads Botafogo’s players in fouls suffered in the Brasileirão, with 29 penalties drawn. He also ranks among the top defenders, with 9 interceptions and 12 tackles in the competition. These figures show the midfielder’s active role in defensive coverage.

European interest: Atlético Madrid and Manchester City in pursuit

Atlético Madrid has already started negotiations to try to finalize Montoro’s transfer in the short term. Manchester City has also expressed interest, underscoring the Argentine youngster’s potential to shine in European leagues.

Impact on Brazilian football: what lies ahead?

International attention on Montoro could pave the way for more Brazilian players to gain visibility abroad. The contract renewal and offers from major European clubs also reinforce the market value of Brasileirão athletes as assets.
